title: Public strategy requests and real display names
description: Reverse the private/team-scoped design of 'Strategy requests' (strategy_requests/request_votes, never shown on the map, visible only to the submitter/their team) so requests become public, map-visible, social geo.features rows reusing the unified intervention layer, click-to-inspect detail panel, and feature_likes/feature_comments backend just shipped for interventions. Also closes the known 'no user-directory lookup' gap flagged by that same track by adding a users.name-backed display-name directory used consistently in comments, submissions, and requests.

dependencies.note: Just shipped the merged intervention layer, click-to-inspect InterventionDetailModal, and the generic feature_id-scoped feature_likes/feature_comments backend this track reuses verbatim for strategy requests. Also the source of the explicitly named 'no user-directory lookup' known gap (InterventionCommentThread.tsx authorLabel) this track closes.

Source of the InterventionGeometrySchema/area-cap validation this track reuses unchanged for a request's Point geometry (OQ-F), and of the land/air InterventionCategorySchema/InterventionType vocabulary this track extends with water_harvesting (OQ-D).

castModerationVote/transitionLifecycleState remains the dead, non-authoritative status vocabulary; this track's direct-to-published request path (OQ-A) must not route through or resemble that pipeline.

owns: src/lib/server/db/schema.ts (drop strategyRequests/requestVotes/priorityZones; extend InterventionType union with water_harvesting)
New users router / getDisplayNames procedure, location TBD in Phase 1 (candidate: src/lib/server/trpc/routers/users.ts)
touches: src/lib/server/trpc/routers/intervention-social.ts (regression test only, per FR-2 -- no expected procedure changes)
src/lib/map/layers.ts and src/lib/map/layer-registry.ts (only if Phase 1 confirms a visual request/recommendation distinction is wanted)
